protocol: Cycle ergometer, 60 min at 55% of maximum work rate (WRmax from incremental test starting 120 W, +25 W/min), then 10 min recovery and 3 x 20 s maximal sprints; capillary glucose and lactate at rest and at 20, 40, 60 min; placebo arm of Ecklonia cava crossover (placebo 30 min before)
population: 12 trained male cyclists, 25 +/- 2 y, BMI 21.3 +/- 2.0, VO2max 50.0 +/- 8.4 mL/kg/min
note: Table 1 gives the session mean over the 60 min, not each sampled minute; sprint-phase glucose and lactate in Table 2. Read the placebo column only; WRmax in watts is not tabulated in the participant description (check the text).
